subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Which canonical split should own the remaining multi-agent orchestration work after the current config, OAuth, and failover mitigations?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses session persistence, subagent completion delivery, fallback cancellation, and operator recovery, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent ownership and compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Repairs
options.body: Keep #43367 open as the tracking umbrella while #86538, #92433, #89927, #96975, and #49603 resolve their narrower contracts and proofs.

options.title: Split Then Close Umbrella
options.body: Move any missing evidence into the focused issues and close this umbrella only after maintainers confirm no remaining cross-cutting acceptance criteria.

options.title: Sponsor Broad Orchestration Design
options.body: Convert the remaining work into a deliberate design effort for session ownership and completion semantics before accepting implementation PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Repairs
recommendation.body: Keep #43367 open as the tracking umbrella while #86538, #92433, #89927, #96975, and #49603 resolve their narrower contracts and proofs.

likelyOwner.reason: Current session/subagent source history points to vincentkoc as the best available owner for the affected implementation surface.
